newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait says backs Arab resolutions on Israel.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait says backs Arab resolutions on Israel.

text.p: A Kuwaiti minister said on Monday his country supported Arab League resolutions recommending Arab states freeze the normalisation of ties with Israel, Radio Kuwait reported.
The remarks by Minister of State for Cabinet Affairs Abdul-Aziz al-Dakhil, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation, came at the end of a two-day Arab foreign ministers meeting in Cairo.

The Arab League resolutions "were intended to preserve Arab rights and save the peace process", Dakhil was quoted as saying. He said they "were intended as a message to Israel on the need for it to comply with the agreements it had signed during the peace process".
The radio said Dakhil called on "both co-sponsors of the peace process -- the United States and Russia -- to intervene to save the peace process".
Kuwait has no official ties with Israel.
